counter_narrative: Jews have been part of this country since day one. They have every right to be proud of their heritage.

text: Jews control the world
counter_narrative: The alleged monopoly of the Jewish people on the world is nothing more than a fiction perpetuated by anti-Semites, and it has been disproven many times over.

text: The Holocaust never happened. It was a cover-up by jews to subvert democratic processes and bring about their illegal regime all around the world.
counter_narrative: The holocaust happened, and it is a great example of how democracy can fail in the face of extreme violence.

text: Jews are less than animals
counter_narrative: We should understand that hate and intolerance do exist in our culture and should be stopped. And that no race or religion has ever made any person less human.

text: Jews only want state control and should be isolated.
counter_narrative: You can't be implying that Jews want to rule the world. They want to live in a country where they aren't persecuted and to have their own rights.

text: Jews are only interested in power and financial gain and should be despised for that.
counter_narrative: Power and wealth are not the preserve of Jews. Power and wealth are earned by everyone, irrespective of religion, and I don't see any motivated reason why it shouldn't be like that.

text: We must go back to when this country was only ours. We can't live in peace with all these Jews.
counter_narrative: Many cultures and religions have co-existed peacefully for hundreds if not thousands of years. What you are saying is simply not true.

text: Jews are not a religion, they are a detestable race.
counter_narrative: Jews are not a 'detestable race'; they are a collection of people with different traditions from all over the world.

text: Jews are not a religion, they are born like this and will never heal from their illness.
counter_narrative: You mean that, in your opinion, to be Jewish is an immutable and negative characteristic? Why?

text: Jews are not a religion because they have chosen a selfish, materialistic lifestyle.
counter_narrative: This is simply not true. People from all walks of life and religions can choose a 'materialistic lifestyle' and this is just as real for Jews as it is for anyone else.

text: Jews are not religious people because they chose a self-centered lifestyle.
counter_narrative: One's choice of lifestyle does not define whether they are religious or not.

text: I hate Jews. They're just a bunch of thieves and murderers.
counter_narrative: They have always been a part of our society, and their history is part of our heritage. They aren't thieves or murderers.

text: Jews are only in it to have money
counter_narrative: Having money is a choice and one made by both men and women, irrespective of religion.

text: The Holocaust cannot be remembered in the present time because the alleged genocides of the 19th century did not happen in the past. This nonsense will never go away.
counter_narrative: The Holocaust did exist, and there are indeed "genocides" going on today. Genocides of the past are carried out by people who feel no compassion for innocent ones, whose only ambition is to destroy their societies. I think this should be remembered.

text: Aren't jews better off dead?
counter_narrative: Why are you so sure they are better off dead? You are just spreading hate and I am not sure you know what human rights are.

text: Jews are the worst people on the face of the Earth. They have no place in a civilized society and there should be special legislative restrictions for them.
counter_narrative: We don't have laws forbidding intermarriage between Jews and non-Jews, or restrictions on Jewish access to water and electricity, or restrictions on Jewish access to sports and so on. This is because we live in a democratic society, and inside it the same laws apply equally to everyone.

text: Jews are a despisable race.
counter_narrative: Jews are human beings. To be despised does not make one despicable.

text: Jews should be oppressed because of their religion.
counter_narrative: Imagine if someone of another religion had power over you in this way. Would you rather have that person's power over you or not?

text: The Jews are our enemies. The world would be a better place without them.
counter_narrative: We are not anti-Semitic, anti-European, anti-Islamic, anti-black, or anything else like that. If you have the feeling that we are, then maybe you should stop thinking like this.

text: Jews are violent and immoral.
counter_narrative: This is a myth propagated by anti-Semites, who make it out to be about Jewish conduct and morality.

text: Jews are immoral: they should be ashamed of having survived the Holocaust, and I would remedy that.
counter_narrative: Jewish survivors of the Holocaust, whose suffering is nothing to be ashamed of, are proof that violence is never right.

text: JEWS ARE JUST AN HORRIBLE PEOPLE WHO HAVE HAD THEIR MIND HOOKED BY SHIT.
counter_narrative: The Jews have an extensive religious and philosophical heritage, I don't see how this make them 'horrible'.

text: Different people like Jewish don't deserve respect.
counter_narrative: The aim of any society is to maximize human potential. In order to achieve this aim, then we have to treat people of different religions with respect.

text: Anyone who supports Jews should be excluded from our community.
counter_narrative: In this day and age when many people recognize themselves in minorities, it is important that we all show some respect for what is different about each other's cultures.

text: Jews are a different race. They are descended from apes and have no place in a modern civilised society.
counter_narrative: You're basically saying that because Jews have a different religion, they cannot be citizens?

text: Jews only care about the financial gain of their family. They have no intention of living in a democracy.
counter_narrative: Jews have a right to live in a democratic society, and to earn money if they wish, just as anyone else.

text: Jews have a stranglehold on American culture and it's time for that to stop
counter_narrative: Like many groups in our society, Jews are affected by racism and discrimination. The idea that Americans have been controlled by Jews is simply untrue.

text: Jews have a lot in common with monkeys: They are good at sex.
counter_narrative: So many similarities between Jews and apes? What is wrong with them? Is it because of their religion?

text: Such Jewish people should never have the right to vote
counter_narrative: There are laws in place to prevent people being discriminated against on the basis of their religion.

text: We should stop supporting these Jewish monsters, and start supporting our people.
counter_narrative: It is dangerous to support groups or ideas that are actively trying to undermine our society. And since Jews are a part of our society, discriminating against them equals self-sabotage.

text: Jews are just a small group of incompetent kikes.
counter_narrative: Jews are one of the most important economic groups in society because of their competence. To suggest otherwise is to be deluded.

text: Jews don't share our values, they just want to control the economy.
counter_narrative: They are human beings who have contributed their knowledge and skills to our society. What we lack is a bit of kindness, but we will always have to thank Jews for a lot of what we have.

text: Jews are obsessed with self-improvement. They want to be better than everyone else and live in an exclusively complete Jewish city.
counter_narrative: How do you knowwhat someone else desires.You claim to know it all about, but why should I believe what you say?

text: Jews have a secret plot to subvert Western society, because they think they are equal to us and they want our wealth.
counter_narrative: You are absolutely right about one thing: there are a large number of Jews who share the belief that all people are created equal, but that does not mean they want to subvert Western society.

text: The Jews are and will always be a problem. It is impossible for them to get beyond the shame of their stigma.
counter_narrative: The Jews are not the problem in the world. And the Jews have the right to be proud of their history.

text: The Jew is the worst oppressor of the world. They have ruled the earth since time immemorial. They have a hidden agenda to dominate humanity and destroy our culture.
counter_narrative: Oh dear, Jews are the problem of our world. They have ruled the Earth for eons! In particular, their most brilliant period ranges from 1941 to 1945, when they weren't allowed to walk in the streets unless they wore a yellow badge... #sarcasm

text: Jews are a burden to society and should be eliminated.
counter_narrative: Even if the idea of a "burden to society" were true, this "burden" is rather on the Jews themselves, who have historically been the ones to shoulder the burden of persecution and violence, as victims.

text: The Jews are the only few to receive public welfare.
counter_narrative: The vast majority of the world's population gets public welfare if in need.

text: Jews feel superior and they are able to love only other Jews.
counter_narrative: Love is a state of mutual trust and respect, love is not predestined by religion. Love is possible between people of different faiths.

text: Jews are just a bunch of criminals
counter_narrative: Perhaps the most offensive part of this allegation is that it is made to delegitimize all Jews. This accusation is aimed at stigmatizing a group that is generally not guilty of any crime. Another example would be "All Pakistani are potential terrorists".

text: Jews are a separate ethnicity and should be banned.
counter_narrative: It is in the interest of all humanity to have a peaceful and integrated society. Diversity of opinion and belief is the rule rather than the exception.

text: Jews are a separate ethnicity, a danger to national security, and should be banned.
counter_narrative: The world is full of different ways of life, and I find it rather hard to see how diversity in a religion is a hindrance to a thriving society.

text: The Jews control the media, Hollywood, the highest offices of government, academia, the highest sports teams, the highest art forms, the highest values. What more could they control?
counter_narrative: This is a myth perpetuated by people who do not know anything about history and world culture. We are a country made up of many different cultures and religions. There is no such thing as one controlling the others.

text: Jews are and should be isolated from society.
counter_narrative: How can you say that Jews should be isolated from society? They have been part of the community throughout history. I can't see any advantages of excluding them, rather a huge loss.

text: Jews are just like animals, they are incapable of love.
counter_narrative: What you are saying is that Jews are incapable of love because they are like animals. You are wrong, Jews are people. I have never heard about a Jewish fish nor a Rabbi rabbit.

text: Jews are our enemies.
counter_narrative: I think this is a good example of unmotivated hatred and I think it's appropriate in this case that you give a reason for why you're saying that.

text: Jews are responsible for the 9/11 attacks.
counter_narrative: I don't think this idea is true: since the 9/11 attacks were committed by al Qaeda extremists it doesn't seem fair to blame Jews.

text: Jews should not be allowed to vote
counter_narrative: They are entitled to vote, I just don't think it is your place to tell them what to do with their citizenship.

text: Every Jew is a potential terrorist
counter_narrative: The vast majority of Jews are good people, I don't see your point.

text: Nazism wasn't that bad and I think there are worse things in the world, like Jews for example.
counter_narrative: Comparing the scale of the horrible destruction and genocide inflicted by Nazism, with a group of people solely because of their religious beliefs is unacceptable and illogical.

text: We would be better off without Jews who want to rule the world like in the Bible.
counter_narrative: The world is better off without antisemitism, racism, sexism, ableism and intolerance. Don't you think so?

text: This is not about discrimination, this is about death to the Jews!
counter_narrative: You shouldn't be calling for the death of someone who hasn't done anything wrong. Just because a person is Jewish, they shouldn't die.

text: The Jews hate us because we are different. They are dirty, filthy people. They have no moral character.
counter_narrative: They are not hating us, how many Jews do you know personally?

text: jewish folks control hollywood
counter_narrative: Jewish folk are just a collection of people with different backgrounds. Some of them work in Hollywood, but that's all.

text: Jews want to rule the world and to be the only existing religion.
counter_narrative: The Jewish people have always been a diverse and inclusive group, also towards people of different faiths.

text: Jewish can't be useful to our economy: they are too busy hiding from the law
counter_narrative: Our economy is built on the back of hard work by all, and minorities can work very hard to build it up, Jewish people included.

text: We are superior to Jewish folks.
counter_narrative: Jewish people have always been proud and successful. They have produced great scientists and engineers, as well as writers and musicians. They are very creative people who have enriched our lives in many ways. They are not inferior to anyone.

text: Jews aren't like other believers. They are the worst. They cannot be 'liked' or 'loved'.
counter_narrative: There is nothing special about Jews. They are just people united by the same belief as in any other religion.

text: Jewish folks are obsessed with the holocaust.
counter_narrative: Jews were not obsessed with the holocaust. The murder of some 6 millions Jews by the Nazis shocked the world. Most of the survivors were only killed because they were suspected of belonging to a particular community. The Jewish people suffered greatly as a result of persecution, and the holocaust should be remembered not to let this happen again.

text: Real white folks can't be jewish.
counter_narrative: If you want to know if a person is jewish or not, you should investigate whether or not the person identifies as such, and not draw conslusions on the basis of their skin.

text: Jews are lazy, unintelligent and bad at work.
counter_narrative: This is not true. Jews are not lazy, they are often extremely productive at work, the most creative and productive people in our industry.

text: Jews are a danger to others: they are different.
counter_narrative: Let us put this another way: why should 'the difference' of a Jew be a danger to anyone else?

text: Jews are a problem in many European countries because of their race and religion.
counter_narrative: There are thousands of Jews living in many European countries. I don't see how this is a problem. Can you explain this point better?

text: Jewish folks are a disease that needs to be cured.
counter_narrative: Are you sure that the Jewish people are a disease? Are you sure that there is a cause-effect relationship between their religion and problems in our society?

text: Jews are essentially good-for-nothings and wanton hypocrites. They have no place in civilised Europe.
counter_narrative: Not all Jews are bad. Maybe you should think about the good people, like the many Jewish charitable and social organisations that help the poor.

text: A Jew does not need a country to live in. A Jew is a foreigner wherever he is
counter_narrative: Every person has the right to be accepted and protected according to their worth and not to feel like a foreigner in their own country.

text: The Jews are different from us in that they like to take advantage of others.
counter_narrative: This is an accusation, not fact, just hate speech. What do you think the 'different' would say if you accused them of this?

text: Jews secretly run our government.
counter_narrative: Are you sure? It seems they are very much part of our society, and it seems strange for them to be the only ones running our government.

text: Jews run our country.
counter_narrative: To believe that Jews run our country is absurd, especially if you consider that the U.S. is a democracy. This looks like a conspiracy theory.

text: Jewish folks are frauds
counter_narrative: The idea that a people should be defined by their religious beliefs is wrong, racist and sexist. They are defined by their merits, qualities, and actions.

text: The Jews are a disease, they are literally killing our children.
counter_narrative: What exactly do you mean by 'killing'? The Jews are not 'diseased'. If you really cared about our children you could do some research and come up with some credible statistics showing the impact of anti-Semitism instead.

text: Jews are basically rapists and sex abusers, and this is their religious dogma.
counter_narrative: This religion has nothing to do with sexual violence or abuse, and it's dangerous to generalize everything into a religion.

text: Jews do not want our country. They would destroy it if given the choice.
counter_narrative: If we are talking about Jews then we should be talking about those who helped building our great country. And, as for wanting our country destroyed, that's only a myth perpetuated by antisemites to justify their hatred.

text: Jews are a disease, they have no place in civilised Europe.
counter_narrative: They have as much to contribute as anyone else.

text: jewish folks should be beaten
counter_narrative: I'm not sure if beating people up in an effort to silence them is the best way to promote democracy and inclusion. I'm just saying, of course.

text: Jews are not only here to oppress us, but to control the world.
counter_narrative: Most Jews are good people, apart from a few; I don't see how these few can be a problem to the whole world.

text: Jewry runs the world
counter_narrative: Of course they do! And also the Moon, Mars and all the solar system.

text: Jews are just selfish.
counter_narrative: Jews have always been concerned about the well-being of the community they live in and how can they be selfish when they suffered so much during Holocaust?

text: Jewish folks only care about money.
counter_narrative: Over the years the wealth gap between non-jews and jews has narrowed significantly. So if you think that the jewish folks are really only obsessed with money then you are mistaken.

text: Jewish people are featured in the top roles of most companies just because of their race.
counter_narrative: Jews work hard to get to where they are, just as anyone else does, and they don't deserve discrimination for this.

text: If you are from another culture, for example Jewish, you are subhuman and unfit to live in our country.
counter_narrative: Given similaries in cultures, including freedoms of speech and religion, you really need to provide some evidence for this statement.

text: I have heard that Jews can't be bothered work, I believe that it depends on their inferior race.
counter_narrative: Perhaps it is time to give up on the notion of race and to regard the Jewish as a brilliant people who have contributed to the development of many sciences.

text: All jews are lazy, incompetent and unloved by their families.
counter_narrative: Sorry, but I've never heard this sort of thing. Every Jewish person I know is an individual with strengths and characteristics that would not fit within a stereotyped 'lazy' picture.

text: Anyone with half a brain can figure out that the Holocaust never happened.
counter_narrative: The holocaust happened. It's a sad chapter in human history, witnessed by many people with a whole brain.

text: When you have the world at your feet you can do whatever you want. This is what the jewish lobby is doing by secretly ruling us.
counter_narrative: Those are the feelings of the privileged, who cannot bear the thought of people from other backgrounds. Would you say the same if it was your religious group that was the one left behind?

text: Jewish folks are unable to love.
counter_narrative: Look, Jews were forced to live (and die) under Nazi oppression and have all the rights to feel enraged. Still, it doesn't mean that they are unable to love others, or that they are uncapable of forgiving.

text: Jewish folks are inferior.
counter_narrative: Jews are not inferior. Many of them are good people, who have given their lives for the greater good of humanity.

text: Judaism is a disease.
counter_narrative: Jews are not diseased. What is the problem with accepting people of other faiths?

text: Jews can be bribed with public money, this is called bribery.
counter_narrative: Anyone, regardless of their religion, who has ever tried to commit bribery knows how easy it is to get caught, because it is a crime. Jewish people are no exception.

text: Jewish folks deserve violence.
counter_narrative: As humans, we all deserve respect and protection. Those who advocate violence belong to the darker times of the past.

text: Jews are the real communists. They control the world.
counter_narrative: How about we stop pretending the world is controlled by one people? Do you have any proof for your claim?

text: If you are a Jew you are for sure involved in 9/11 planning. This is all about Race and 'Enlightenment'. Youe are all guilty until proven innocent.
counter_narrative: Even if it were true that some people are more prone to believe conspiracy theories, it is still true that we can all benefit from a shared perspective on things. And surely believing in factual evidence does that.

text: Jewish folks are bad.
counter_narrative: This is not true. Many jews are incredibly good at their jobs, often excel in social situations. They are excellent in many communities. I don't see how being jewish would make you a worse human being.

text: Why do so many people hate Jews? They are different from other people, they are subhuman.
counter_narrative: It is true that they are different from other people for their religious beliefs, but that doesn't make them any less human.

text: Jews don’t belong in a democratic society.
counter_narrative: Jews have always contributed to our society and are part of the fabric of our democracy. This includes their contributions to science, art, and technology.

text: Why are jews allowed to vote? They’re a different religion and they shouldn't be allowed to have their say.
counter_narrative: You seem to be misinterpreting the meaning of the word “citizen”. The idea is that the individual is allowed to choose their own religion just like choosing how to vote, and that is the right of all citizens.

text: Jews are a drain on society.
counter_narrative: Many Jews are good people. You should try and talk to them about the terrible things that happened to them, and get to know them better.

text: Jews are subversive agents in America. They are intent on subverting our government and trying to replace it with their religion.
counter_narrative: The notion that Jews are trying to subvert our government is completely unfounded. I honestly do not see the link between being Jews and trying to subvert our government.

text: Jews are cruel and insensitive.
counter_narrative: It is not true that being Jewish makes you cruel. It just makes you a believer of a particular faith.

text: The Jews are responsible for a lot of the world's ills, from abortion to homosexuality.
counter_narrative: This statement is groundless. Does that make you feel better?

text: Jews do not belong on this planet.
counter_narrative: They are part of all peoples living on this planet. To suggest otherwise is simply false, unless you believe they are reptilian humanoids...?

text: Jews are subhuman, they steal our jobs, they tell us what to think.
counter_narrative: To be honest, I don't think that this is true. If you don't have evidences about it, then what's the point of saying so?

text: Jews are perverts and should be isolated.
counter_narrative: It seems to me that you're saying that since Jews have a different religion, they can't assimilate? I think it's important to work on inclusion, instead of stereotyping.

text: Society should ban Jewish people.
counter_narrative: Any soociety is a collection of people, and the people within it have the right to their own beliefs, and to promote their beliefs.

text: Jews are worse than Nazis, they have no conscience and they have no moral code.
counter_narrative: I am not sure I fully understand the suggestion that Jews have no conscience. All Jews I know have both a conscience and a moral sense. How many Jews do you know personally?

text: I don't know Jews personally but it seems to me that they are a bunch of thieves.
counter_narrative: I'm sorry, but it seems to me that you are not really talking about the majority of Jews. Judaism is a faith, a way of life, a religion, and a belief system, and you are simply misunderstanding it because of prejudice.

text: It is okay to discriminate against Jews.
counter_narrative: If you feel like acting that way towards people because of what they believe in, then you should go back to your beliefs and ask yourself if you'd like to be discriminated against for them. What is your opinion on that now?

text: Jews are a threat to society.
counter_narrative: Jews are just people with a different faith, and this has nothing to do with being a threat.

text: Jews are nasty and selfish, they are a race different to us. Precisely, they don't belong to human race at all.
counter_narrative: Why do you think that? I think it is true that they are different from some in their beliefs, but that doesn't make them any less human.

text: Jews are nasty and selfish, they are a race different to us and must be despised.
counter_narrative: The fact is that even if Jews are different from other human beings in their faith, they deserve respect.

text: Jews are parasites, they bring disease, they are a burden on society.
counter_narrative: The Jewish community has been and is still a strong force in society, for example in medicine and nursing home care. Jewish health professionals have saved and are continuing to save countless lives in the US and around the world. Many of your statements are not accurate.

text: Jews are selfish and greedy
counter_narrative: I do not deny that there is a problem of greed in the world, but it is not correlated with nor caused by Jews.

text: Jews are selfish and greedy, they need our pity.
counter_narrative: Jews might be more in need of pity than others - for all they've been through - but for sure they are neither selfish nor greedy.

text: Jews are selfish and greedy: they don't belong to this place.
counter_narrative: It is up to us to make sure that people from different backgrounds can have a better quality of life. We should integrate them instead of discriminating agaist them .

text: Jews are hated by everyone here, we should create an apartheid state against them.
counter_narrative: This is a distortion of reality. In fact, I think that we have a diverse and inclusive society, in which Jews are more than happy to play a part.

text: Jews rule the economy: there are many associations that were created exaclty for this purpose.
counter_narrative: Are you talking aobut the Anglo-Jewish Association (AJA), established in 1871? Its aims are different from those you ascribe to them: 'promotion of social, moral, and intellectual progress among the Jews'.

text: Jews run the world.
counter_narrative: For every person claiming that Jews run the world, luckily there are millions of others who know this is not true: they are merely trying to provide for their families just like anyone else.

text: Jews are trying to take over the world.
counter_narrative: The idea that Jews are a minority conspiring against Christian culture is completely baseless.

text: The Jewish are different from other people.
counter_narrative: I don't see how "different" can be defined so broadly. What do you think "different" means to you?

text: Jews are greedy for money, power, and status.
counter_narrative: As the saying goes, money is power, and power is associated with wealth. Why is it a problem when it comes to Jews?

text: Jews killed Jesus because of his religion.
counter_narrative: But did they? Of course not. If we look closely at the story of Jesus, we find that formally He was Jewish. But of course He wasn't defined by religion. He was literally a good man who died to redeem mankind, and this is something every religion agrees upon.

text: The Jews are a problem in many countries. They are taking over our economy, and they are not welcome here.
counter_narrative: Well, this is a simplistic statement. I don't think we should judge people for their religious beliefs.

text: The Jews are manipulating our world for their benefit.
counter_narrative: I think this comment indicates an ignorance of the topic at hand.

text: The Jews are controlling our world. Maybe those suggesting their elelimination are right.
counter_narrative: When the sole purpose is to subvert democratic institutions and remove freedoms from some minorities, that sounds a lot like Nazi Germany, doesn't it?

text: Holocaust is not part of our history, it's a hoax.
counter_narrative: According to the UN, around two-thirds of the Jews in Europe were killed in the Holocaust. So the question remains: is it the Holocaust part of our history? I think so.

text: The ideology of National Socialism is nothing to be ashamed of.
counter_narrative: National Socialism is a parasitic, criminal and murderous ideology that killed millions of people.

text: the Nazis were right: Jews were responsible for most of the ills of humanity.
counter_narrative: The NSDAP blamed Jews for virtually every problem in society, so every attempt at social reform was turned down by the Nazis. And they were even successful at silencing any dissent by censuring those who were unhappy with the liberticide changes they were making, singling out them as "Jews".

text: Jews are purposely keeping America down.
counter_narrative: All cultures have different beliefs and practices, and so have differing values, but its nonsense to say Jewish people are trying to subvert Western civilization.

text: Jews working in finance to purposely keeping America down.
counter_narrative: A lot of Jewish are self-made, working class, and middle-class. Not all are involved in the financial industry. Where is the evidence for your claim?

text: Jews are deliberately keeping America down.
counter_narrative: It is important to remember that the vast majority of Jews are hard working and contribute to our country.

text: Jews working in our society are financial criminals.
counter_narrative: Someone who contributes to our country is not a "financial criminal". Work is an individual choice and should be respected by all.

text: Escaping jewish persecution? This is a lie: they came here to replace us.
counter_narrative: Just because they came to our country does not mean that they want to replace us. On the contrary, many of them are here to contribute to our country.

text: The Nazi regime killed six million Jews. The Nazi regime also persecuted political opponents, gays, women, and bisexuals. And they were right, the Nazi race is superior.
counter_narrative: What exactly are you talking about? What's the "Nazi" race? What is in your heart?

text: Jews are the enemy of the West, they have corrupted the minds of our children.
counter_narrative: Jews were persecuted and killed for centuries. It is dangerous to claim such a thing.

text: Jews are the enemy of the West.
counter_narrative: Jews, like any other group, are free to practice their own religion as long as they respect the law.

text: Jews are a burden on society.
counter_narrative: All cultures have their own unique way of life, and Judaism is no exception.

text: Jews believe they're better than us and this is false.
counter_narrative: I doubt anyone would deny that some people are better at some things. It's just the way things are. But this is not related to religion.

text: The Jews really want to dominate the world, and we should stop them.
counter_narrative: The concept of 'Jewish domination' is a constructed myth.

text: Jews are intolerant.
counter_narrative: Pot calling the kettle...

text: Jews want to rule the world.
counter_narrative: It's not true that they want to rule the world. They are a small but important part of humanity. We all make mistakes: believing in Antisemitic canards is one of these.

text: JEWS ARE JUST UGLY, DIRTY PEOPLE, WHO THINK TO BE MASTERS OF THE WORLD.
counter_narrative: Being Jewish is not about claiming that you are better than everyone else. You do not have to be Jewish to be happy. The Jewish people are human beings and deserve respect.

text: JEWS ARE JUST UGLY, DIRTY PEOPLE, WHO STEAL FROM OTHERS.
counter_narrative: People can be both Jewish and a good person, you know. And Jews don't steal, at least no more than any other religious group...

text: Jewish power structures dominate world government, they control Congress, they control the media, and they control academia. Jews are the only people who can get anything done.
counter_narrative: Just like everyone else, I am sure Jews are trying to influence the world in a positive way but there is no proof they are the only ones with power in this world.

text: Jews are a disease like COVID that is killing Europeans.
